44767-richard-wagner-his-life-and-his-dr.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The ancestry of Richard Wagner has been traced as far as his grandfather. This good man was Gottlob Friedrich Wagner, a custom house official, whose life-work it was to see that nothing was smuggled into Leipsic through the city gates. Gottlob Friedrich had a son to whom was given the second name of his father. Friedrich Wagner was a clerk of police.

arxiv-2512-21246.description: Abstract . The increasing integration of AI tools in education has led prior research to explore their impact on learning processes. pmc-11474322.title: Assessing mental resilience with individual and lifestyle determinants among nursing students: An observational study from Greece
pmc-11474322.creator: Maria Antoniou, Evangelos C Fradelos, Theano Roumeliotaki, Foteini Malli, Emmanouil, K Symvoulakis, Dimitrios Papagiannis

pmc-11484013.title: Case report: Rapid symptom relief in autoimmune encephalitis with efgartigimod: a three-patient case series
pmc-11484013.creator: Qianqian Zhang, Wenping Yang, Yun Qian, Yu Zhang, Huihui Zhao, Mingzhu Shu, Qingyang Li, Yanan Li, Yu Ding, Shiyu Shi, Yaxi Liu, Xi Cheng, Qi Niu
pmc-11484013.description: IntroductionAutoimmune encephalitis (AE) comprises a group of inflammatory brain disorders mediated by autoimmune responses. Anti–N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis, anti–leucine-rich glioma-inactivated 1 (LGI1) encephalitis, and anti–γ-aminobutyric acid-B receptor (GABABR) encephalitis are the most prevalent forms, characterized by the presence of antibodies against neuronal cell-surface antigens. Efgartigimod, an antagonist of the neonatal Fc receptor, has proven efficacy in myasthenia gravis treatment.

pmc-12365199.title: Chip-integrated spectroscopy capable of temperature retrieval
pmc-12365199.creator: Yifan Du, Yong Meng Sua, Santosh Kumar, Jiuyi Zhang, Xiangzhi Li, Yongxiang Hu, Parminder Ghuman, Yuping Huang
pmc-12365199.description: We demonstrate a chip-integrated emission spectrometer capable of retrieving the temperature of the light sources. It consists of a single photon detector with low dark counts and a sweeping on-chip filter with 2 pm spectral resolution in the visible and near-infrared regimes.

pmc-12381236.title: The role of cognitive flexibility and psychological well-being in the effect of mindfulness on problematic internet use
pmc-12381236.creator: Gülin Yazıcı Çelebi, Sunay Güngör, Feridun Kaya
pmc-12381236.description: With the widespread use of digital technologies today, the Internet has become an indispensable part of life but has also led to negative outcomes such as problematic internet use in some individuals. Problematic internet use is seen as a critical risk factor that negatively impacts individuals’ academic, social, and psychological functioning.

pmc-12578784.title: IMT504 accelerates post-hepatectomy liver regeneration in mice with involvement of GLAST + Wnt1 + bone marrow stromal progenitors
pmc-12578784.creator: Maximiliano Borda, Lucía Cafaro, Romina Sierra, Mercedes Díaz Pedraza, Camila Becerra, Agustina Ábalo, María José Karolewski, María José Cantero, Máximo Schiavone, Guillermo D Mazzolini, Alejandro Montaner, Esteban J Fiore, Jorge B Aquino
pmc-12578784.description: The immunomodulatory oligodeoxynucleotide (ODN) IMT504 exhibits antifibrotic and pro-regenerative properties in the context of liver fibrosis. It also enhances the contribution of GLAST+ Wnt1+ bone marrow stromal progenitors (BMSPs) to liver regeneration in a mouse model of chronic liver disease. In this study, partial hepatectomy (PHx) was performed in CD1 mice.

pmc-12616961.title: Profiles of PCSK9, SREBP-2, and histopathology in COVID-19 and non-COVID-19 critical illness
pmc-12616961.creator: Florian Weber, Vlad Pavel, Martina Müller, Peter Boor, Lea Läber, Saskia von Stillfried, Christa Buechler
pmc-12616961.description: BackgroundSevere illness caused by SARS-CoV-2 infection is associated with dysregulated cholesterol homeostasis. Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9), which regulates serum cholesterol levels, is induced in the plasma of patients with severe SARS-CoV-2 infection, compared to critically ill patients with other conditions. PCSK9 is primarily expressed in the liver, which is susceptible to damage during severe illness.

pmc-12813869.title: Spatially fractionated radiation therapy for treating recurrent glioblastoma: a dosimetric feasibility study
pmc-12813869.creator: Yuwei Zhou, Sean Tanny, Michael T. Milano, Brian Marples, Fiona Li, Hyunuk Jung, Matthew Webster, Alexander R. Podgorsak, Jihyung Yoon, Wesley Rivais, Michael J. Hazoglou, Dandan Zheng
pmc-12813869.description: ObjectiveSpatially fractionated radiation therapy (SFRT) shows promise for treating bulky, advanced, or recurrent tumors. To evaluate the feasibility of SFRT for patients with recurrent glioblastoma (GBM), we conducted a planning study involving 14 patients, analyzing vertex target volume (VTV) contours and cumulative doses to both targets and organs at risk (OARs).

pmc-13380032.creator: Xiaojing Gao, Yan Zhang, Lingna Guo, Huimin Zhang, Jianwen Sun, Jianfang Sun, Weidong Huang
pmc-13380032.description: Nucleotide bis‐(3,5)‐cyclic di‐guanosine monophosphate (c‐di‐GMP) is a universal and versatile secondary messenger. It is involved in the regulation of significant functions such as motility, biofilm formation, virulence, drug resistance, cell cycle, differentiation, and many other physiological processes in bacteria. In this study, we focused on the multidomain c‐di‐GMP metabolizing protein PA2072 from Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1.

uslaw-usc-t22-s2507b.title: 22 U.S.C. § 2507b — Sexual assault policy
uslaw-usc-t22-s2507b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s2507b.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 34 (The Peace Corps). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general The President shall develop and implement a comprehensive sexual assault policy that— (1) includes a system for restricted and unrestricted reporting of sexual assault; (2) mandates, for each Peace Corps country program, the designation of a Sexual Assault Response Liaison.
